dispositions.sourceConcept: camera capture begins only after an explicit visitor action
pose inference and video remain local, with normalized landmarks as the measuring input
runtime and model fetched from jsDelivr and Google Storage at visit time

dispositions.sourceConcept: mirrored camera/skeleton display and raw landmarks exposed through window.latestPose

dispositions.sourceConcept: a separate requestAnimationFrame loop driven by video.currentTime
dispositions.reason: sampling is bounded and keyed by caller-supplied absolute river time; the pure engine retains no clock or state

dispositions.sourceConcept: single-person proof with one combined denied-or-unavailable error and no fallback
dispositions.reason: the canonical adapter distinguishes permission, absence, dropout, reconnect, and re-entry; supports four visitors; and provides keyboard/touch controls
interaction is now an optional control on the canonical artwork root; the legacy page is removed and remains excluded from the Pages artifact
